Lol i had to laugh when i read your "Easy Single Serving Hot Chocolate" at 1:33. Easy? Yes. ... but a lot of work to cook and to clean up. Absolutely not worth the time. do you want to know how you can make the absolute best Hot chocolate in short amount of time with little work and not needing to clean a lot? (for all the lazy people out there)  Hot Milk (200-250ml) Your favourite Quality chocolate (Red Lindor Balls from Lindt!) (1g to 1kg, depending on your desired consistency, drinkable .... chewable) pinch of salt, or one tiny shake from the salt shaker stir with spoon. finished.  If you feel like being picasso and it is not fancy enough: use some nutmeg, cinnamon, cocoa powder, marshmallows, a dash of whipped cream or whatever. (Depending of the amount of work and time you want to put in)  You need to do some experiments and find out which chocolate tastes good, which one dissolves quickly and how much you need for 1 Mug of Milk. Then you basically have instant high quality hot chocolate
